project.name: LaunchPad
project.summary: A WebMCP-native evidence factory where browser agents research, challenge, and trace one defensible solution while humans retain control of sensitive decisions.
project.ai_usage: ChatGPT's in-app browser tested the live WebMCP journey; an OpenAI-compatible Responses API powers autonomous web research and provider-backed tool-selection evals.
project.codex_usage: Codex analyzed and strengthened the architecture, implemented and tested the WebMCP protocol, verified the public deployment, and prepared the submission evidence.
